options.extraction: 8-neighbor Canny skeleton primitive traces; no gap repair, curve smoothing or source-guided joins. Longest eligible trace, tie lexical endpoints. No message likelihood in trace selection.
options.orientation: Observed endpoints lexicographic; observed normalized arc length; lateral position relative to observed endpoint chord.
options.caveat: A deliberately simple first self-reference receiver, not an optimal blind receiver.

codebook.key_role: Only relabels the four legal states; provides no authentication. Wrong-key presence is mathematically invariant.

data.Cal: Six4A Cal contents x2 views x(clean+4words), plus32 Stage4B Cal clean contents. No old4A Eval.
data.Eval: Exact existing Stage4B48 marked RGB +128 clean RGB. Twelve marked contents; paired12 clean included in128. Reused held-out diagnostic evaluation, not a newly generated independent validation.

methods.R0: Frozen4B reference-assisted receiver, source geometry+clean coefficient+all4 actual source codewords+original channel/presence.
methods.R0_public: Same geometry and clean coefficient, replace actual-input source book by nominal public book with original Cal channel.
methods.R1_zero_clean: R0_public without clean subtraction, no recalibration; isolates the direct subtraction removal.
methods.R1_public: Same source-assisted geometric synchronization; no clean coefficient, actual-input book or admission flag passed to classifier. Public absolute-coefficient centers fitted on Cal.
methods.R2_tube: RGB + fixed source tube Mask + public Cal decoder + Key; source-shaped Mask is auxiliary side information.
methods.R2_bbox: RGB + rectangular Mask bounds + public Cal decoder + Key; retains location/extent, removes detailed tube shape.
methods.R3: RGB + public rules + Key; no Mask or per-image source fields. Longest geometric trace selected before coefficient decoding.

tuning: Natural baseline degree0/1/2 and geometric fit residual/CI limits selected on Cal by leave-one-content-out full-message correct-2*wrong. Degrees3/4 recorded but rank-deficient => erasure. No Eval tuning.
presence: Cal public clean Gaussian vs4 marked centers; Cal clean95% threshold, all receive failures score -1e6. Empirical small-Cal diagnostic, not1%FPR certification.
identifiability: Project S/T out of natural polynomial baseline B=[1,x,...,x^r]; report residual energy, Gram eig/condition/rank and six public codeword residual distances. Robust real-valued estimation, not RS.
